messages.subject: Executive Introduction | ESG, External Affairs & Energy Transition
messages.body:
Dear Natasha,

I am reaching out directly given your work with GreenSearch and Haybury across international energy and leadership markets.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder engagement.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates, particularly where energy transition, responsible development and institutional engagement intersect.

My current executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
